title: Jeff Satur Signs With Universal Music Southeast Asia
summary: UM SEA has tentatively scheduled a Q2 2027 release date for Satur’s next album, his first through the major music company.
contentText:
Thai artist Jeff Satur is the latest signing to Universal Music Southeast Asia, a division of Universal Music Group.

The singer, songwriter, producer and actor partners-up with UM SEA ahead of the anticipated release next year of his sophomore studio album, which will be followed by his first solo stadium concert in Bangkok, and a world tour in late 2027 through 2028.

With an audience spanning southeast Asia, into South America and the United States, Satur joins the UM SEA roster with two billion-plus streams under his belt, including such hits as “Fade,” “Dum Dum,” “Hide,” “Ghost” and “Black Tie.”

“Jeff Satur is an exceptional artist whose creativity and international appeal reflect the enormous potential of Thai music today,” comments Adam Granite , CEO, Universal Music Group, Africa, Middle East and Asia. “This partnership reinforces our commitment to investing in high-potential Thai artists and helping them reach audiences around the world.

Adds Calvin Wong, CEO of Universal Music South East Asia & Korea & SVP, Asia: “Jeff Satur is one of Thailand’s most exciting and distinctive artists, with an impressive career and a passionate international fanbase. We see tremendous potential to take his journey even further with the strength of UMG’s global network behind him.”

Now with the support of UMG’s global network, reads a statement, he will have greater opportunities to introduce global audiences to his music and live performances.

Through the new alliance, UM SEA will support the artists in his endeavors to become T-Pop’s first global superstar, from music development and artistic direction, to marketing and communications strategies, audience growth, world tour support, business opportunities, and collaborations with world-class producers and artists.

He’s on the right track. This year, he became the first Thai artist to participate in a conversation and performance at Global Spin Live at the Grammy Museum in Los Angeles, and to perform live on Good Day New York on WNYW FOX 5.

That’s coming off his 2025 Red Giant Tour, during which Satur performed in Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and Peru, and nailed two sold-out performances at IMPACT Arena in Bangkok, the biggest indoor arena in his homeland.

“At this point in my career, it was important for me to find a partner that truly understands my vision,” Satur remarks, “one that can help me bring my ideas to life without losing what makes them mine. I’m excited for Saturn to meet the Universe and begin the next chapter of creating without borders, because at its heart, music has always been my universal language.”

UM SEA has tentatively scheduled a Q2 2027 release date for Satur’s next album, his first through the major music company. Read Billboard Philippines’ interview with Satur here .
